title: CBIC Streamlines Diamond Imprest Authorisation Scheme & Grants Duty Exemption
content:
# CBIC Streamlines Diamond Imprest Authorisation Scheme & Grants Duty Exemption

Ek important update hai for our diamond industry colleagues! The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ne Diamond Imprest Authorisation (DIA) Scheme ke procedures ko clarify kiya hai aur saath hi duty exemption bhi announce ki hai. This move aims to facilitate smoother operations for eligible diamond exporters.

Here are the key highlights:

*   **Official Instruments:** This update is rolled out through **Circular No. 48/2026-Customs** and **Notification No. 37/2026-Customs**, both dated November 20, 2026.
*   **Scope of Scheme:** The DIA Scheme allows for the import of natural cut and polished diamonds, including semi-processed, half-cut, and broken diamonds, provided each stone weighs no more than 25 cents (1/4 carat). Importantly, laboratory-grown diamonds are *not* covered under this exemption.
*   **Duty Exemption:** Under Notification No. 37/2026-Customs, eligible imports of natural cut and polished diamonds under a valid DIA are now exempt from Basic Customs Duty, Additional Customs Duty, Anti-Dumping Duty, Countervailing Duty, Safeguard Duty, Education Cess, and the Integrated Goods and Services Tax (IGST).
*   **Eligibility Criteria:** To avail this scheme, importers must meet specific conditions, including holding a Two-Star Export House status or higher. They should also have a minimum export performance of US$15 million in cut and polished diamonds in each of the preceding three financial years and must have filed all GST and income-tax returns for these years.
*   **Import Limits:** The permitted import value is capped at 5% of the average annual export performance of the preceding three years, subject to a maximum of US$15 million.
*   **Export Obligation:** A minimum value addition of 10% is mandatory, which must be realised in free foreign exchange. The export obligation needs to be fulfilled within 18 months from the date of authorisation issuance, with no extensions allowed. The import authorisation itself is valid for 12 months.
*   **Operational Route:** All imports and exports under this scheme must be routed exclusively through Mumbai Airport, with customs clearance at the Precious Cargo Customs Clearance Centre (PCCCC).

This clarification brings much-needed ease and clarity for our diamond exporters, ensuring a more streamlined process for international trade.
